# dsh-file-pane
A VS Code/Codex-style file pane for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) right sidebar: the tree stays on the
right while files open on the left, with preview/pin tabs, line-aware file links, path copying, a ri
ght-click terminal, and Copy to Chat.
English | 中文
## Screenshots
**4-pane layout.** The original right pane is split into two: a viewer on the left and the Workspace
file tree on the right. Three panes become four, and code and files stay side by side.
**Copy to Chat.** Select code in the preview and right-click. The `@file #Lx-Ly` reference and the s
elected code are inserted into the composer, without sending.
## Features
- **File pane on the left** — a file opened from the Workspace files tree lands in a pane to the *le
ft* of the tree, so the tree stays visible on the right at a 70/30 split. If DSH cannot split or mov

e the tab, it falls back to the stock behavior.
- **Preview tabs, VS Code-style** — a single click o
pens or replaces the one preview tab; a double click on a file (or on the tab) pins it. Preview tabs

render in italics, and pinning is per session.
- **Line-aware file links** — a chat link to `src/ap
p.ts:42` opens the file in the preview and scrolls to line 42. `:12-20` and `:12:5` (line:column) st

art at line 12; the native `#L42` / `#L42-L50` form works too.
- **Copy paths** — right-click a file
or folder to copy its workspace-relative path (`src/app.ts`) or absolute path; right-click empty sp

ace to copy the workspace root. Relative paths outside the workspace fall back to absolute.
- **Open
Terminal** — right-click a file (it opens in the file's folder), a folder, or empty space in the tr
ee to open a terminal there. The terminal opens as a sibling tab in the file pane, not over the tree

.
- **Copy / Copy to Chat** — select text in the file preview and right-click. *Copy* keeps the nati
ve copy; *Copy to Chat* inserts a `@file #Lx-Ly` reference plus the selected code as a fenced block
into the composer, without sending it.
Example payload:

[代码示例省略，未执行]
ts
export const b = 2

[代码示例省略，未执行]
`
## Install
Tested with DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or just ask the agent in chat:
> Install the dsh-file-pane plugin: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:sinvacn/dsh-file-pane`
The agent runs the command for you (it needs shell access; approve the command if asked). Either way
, **dsh-file-pane** is added to your profile and the sidebar row is registered automatically. If the
plugin is off, enable it in **Settings → Plugins**.
Refresh the page once; restart the desktop app if the sidebar does not update.

Then refresh the page.
## Limitations

- The right sidebar's total width cap is unchanged; existing splits keep their real ratio.
- If you
keep the tree on the left yourself, files and terminals open in the right-hand sibling pane instead

of swapping panes.
- Line ranges come from code and plain-text previews; Markdown/PDF previews inser

t the file reference and selected text without numbers.
- A file whose name literally ends in `:<dig

its>` is treated as a line reference by chat links (rare).
- Copy to Chat only inserts into the comp

oser; it never sends. Without a mounted composer, the payload is copied to the clipboard instead.
-
The terminal changes into the target directory after it starts, so the `cd …` command stays in shell
history and scrollback.
